ambusher.name: Ambusher
ambusher.description: Unit can be deployed anywhere on its owners side of the table.

arcaneWeb.name: Arcane Web
arcaneWeb.description: Reduce target units movement speed to 0 for one turn.

auraOfProtection.name: Aura of Protection
auraOfProtection.description: Maiden and retinue rerolls 1s on Damage Saves.

auraOfVengeance.name: Aura of Vengeance
auraOfVengeance.description: Paladin and retinue rerolls 1s on Attack Rolls.

bannerOfMist.name: Banner of Mist
bannerOfMist.description: Unit counts as being in Cover. (-1 to Ranged attack rolls against it).

bloodFrenzy.name: Blood Frenzy
bloodFrenzy.description: Target unit loses D3 wounds and gains +1 Attack this turn.

bloodFury.name: Blood Fury
bloodFury.description: +2 Attacks this turn. Activate once per battle when wounded.

bodyguard.name: Bodyguard
bodyguard.description: If a Commander is part of this unit it re-rolls failed Discipline tests.

boulderThrow.name: Boulder Throw
boulderThrow.description: Throw a boulder at an enemy unit. Range 18, 2D3 Power 5.

cruelMotivation.name: Cruel Motivation
cruelMotivation.description: Retinue gets +2 Movement Speed and re-rolls missed Attack Rolls for one Turn. It loses one model.

cursedStandard.name: Cursed Standard
cursedStandard.description: Unit has +1 Attack this turn. Activate once per battle.

deadlyStrike.name: Deadly Strike
deadlyStrike.description: Activate once per battle. Melee attacks deal 2x wounds against multiwound targets for one turn.

demonic.name: Demonic
demonic.description: Never fails Discipline tests, loses D3 wounds on lost combat.

demonicPossession.name: Demonic Possession
demonicPossession.description: Gain +3 Attacks this turm. Lose 1 Wound.

divineFavour.name: Divine Favour
divineFavour.description: Target unit gets +1 Skill and rerolls failed Discipline tests for one turn.

doomBellAbility.name: Doom Bell
doomBellAbility.description: All your units have Frenzy (reroll failed Attack Rolls) this turn. Activate once per battle.

eternalReign.name: Eternal Reign
eternalReign.description: Reduce Crumble by 1. Regeneration (restore all lost wounds at end of turn).

explosiveCharges.name: Explosive Charges
explosiveCharges.description: Range 8. 1D6 power 4. One use per battle.

fearless.name: Fearless
fearless.description: Ignores all penalties to Discipline tests.

feint.name: Feint
feint.description: Target another friendly unit. It immediately makes a retreat move. One use per battle.

fey.name: Fey
fey.description:
Reroll all successful Attack and Ranged Attack rolls against this unit.
Ignores Difficult Terrain.

fieryBlades.name: Fiery Blades
fieryBlades.description: Target unit gets +1 Power on their next Ranged or Close Combat Attack.

forestSpirit.name: Forest Spirit
forestSpirit.description: A spirit of nature. Ignores Difficult Terrain.

frenzy.name: Frenzy
frenzy.description: Re-roll missed Attack Rolls in the first round of combat.

frostWard.name: Frost Ward
frostWard.description: Target unit gets +1 to Damage Saves for one turn. It must re-roll succesfull Attack and Ranged Attack rolls.

furiousCharge.name: Furious Charge
furiousCharge.description: Activate once per battle. Commander and Retinue rerolls Attack Rolls for one turn.

giftOfDecay.name: Gift Of Decay
giftOfDecay.description: Favoured by Decay. +1 Wounds. -1 Move Speed.

giftOfTrickery.name: Gift Of Trickery
giftOfTrickery.description: Favoured by Trickery. Unit has Ambush Deployment and +1 Move Speed. Can Flee from Charges.

giftOfWar.name: Gift Of War
giftOfWar.description: Favoured by War. Unit has Frenzy (re-roll failed Attack Rolls in the first round of combat).

halberd.name: Halberd
halberd.description:
Charge Bonus: +1 Power 
Damage Saves against this weapon are never better than 4+.

hexOfRuin.name: Hex Of Ruin
hexOfRuin.description: Target unit has -2 Defense for one turn.

hidden.name: Hidden
hidden.description: Commander is hidden from your opponent until engaged in combat or damaged.

holyBlade.name: Holy Blade
holyBlade.description: Caster has +1 Power and deals double wounds against Monsters this turn.

horseMasters.name: Horse Masters
horseMasters.description:
Ignores movement penalty from Heavy Armor.
When deployed 3 wide, models in flanks can attack as if in the front rank.

howl.name: Howl
howl.description: All your Northmen are Fearless for one turn. Activate once per battle.

huntersCall.name: Hunters Call
huntersCall.description: All your units have +1 Skill for one turn.

inspireValor.name: Inspire Valor
inspireValor.description: Activate once per battle. Give all your units +1 Combat Score for one turn.

lethalShots.name: Lethal Shots
lethalShots.description: This units ranged attack deals 2x wounds against multiwound targets.

lordOfDecay.name: Lord of Decay
lordOfDecay.description: Once per battle, all friendly units with Gift of Decay re-roll failed damage saves.

lordOfTrickery.name: Lord of Trickery
lordOfTrickery.description: Once per battle, all friendly units with Gift of Trickery gain +3 move speed and Cover for one turn.

lordOfWar.name: Lord Of War
lordOfWar.description: Once per battle, all friendly units with Gift of War gain Deadly Strikes (2x Wounds caused).

mechanicalExpertise.name: Mechanical Expertise
mechanicalExpertise.description: Target Warmachine gets +2 Defense and rerolls 1s on Ranged Attack rolls this battle.

mountainsWill.name: Mountain's Will
mountainsWill.description: Activate once per battle: All your units have +1 Defense for one turn.

packTactics.name: Pack Tactics
packTactics.description: Target a friendly unit that is attacking an enemy unit in the flank/rear. It re-rolls failed Attack rolls this turn.

phaseOut.name: Phase Out
phaseOut.description: Activate for +4 Movement and Flying for one turn.

plague.name: Plague
plague.description: Target unit has -1 Skill and -1 Move Speed. Lasts until end of battle.

potionOfPower.name: Potion of Power
potionOfPower.description: One use, +2 Power and + 1 Attack until end of turn.

powerOfMany.name: Power Of Many
powerOfMany.description: All your Goblins are Fearless for one turn. Activate once per battle.

primalFury.name: Primal Fury
primalFury.description: Target unit has +1 Power and rerolls missed Attack Rolls for one turn.

protectedCrew.name: Crewed Weapon
protectedCrew.description: Always counts as being in Cover. -2 Defense in Close Combat. Unit can't charge.

putridStench.name: Putrid Stench
putridStench.description: Opponents re-roll hits in close combat.

radiantShield.name: Radiant Shield
radiantShield.description: Target unit rerolls failed damage saves for one turn.

raiseDead.name: Raise Dead
raiseDead.description: Raise D3+3 models on a Zombie or Skeleton Warrior, Spear or Archer unit.

rallyingCry.name: Rallying Cry
rallyingCry.description: Rally a fleeing unit. One use per battle.

ranger.name: Ranger
ranger.description: Re-rolls missed ranged Attack rolls. Retinue has +2 Move Speed

realityRift.name: Reality Rift
realityRift.description: Caster and retinue gains Flying and Move Speed 20 for one turn

reanimate.name: Reanimate
reanimate.description: Restore D3+1 wounds to a Reanimated unit.

reanimated.name: Reanimated
reanimated.description: -1 Movement. Never fails Discipline tests, loses D3 wounds on lost combat.

regeneration.name: Regeneration
regeneration.description: Unit recovers all missing wounds at end of turn.

regrowth.name: Regrowth
regrowth.description: Restore D3 wounds to a Forest Spirit unit.

roar.name: Roar!
roar.description: All enemy units have -2 Discipline for one turn. Can only be  activated when damaged.

scout.name: Scout
scout.description: Ignore movement penalties from Difficult Terrain

shroud.name: Shroud
shroud.description: Target unit counts as being in Cover against ranged attacks until it's next combat.

spearshield.name: Spear and Shield
spearshield.description: +1 Defense. Extra Rank supporting attacks when not charging.

sturdy.name: Sturdy
sturdy.description: -1 Movement. Ignore the movement penalty from Heavy Armor.

takeRoot.name: Take Root
takeRoot.description: For one turn, reduce move speed to zero. Re-roll failed damage saves and discipline tests. Activate once per battle.

unholyVigour.name: Unholy Vigour
unholyVigour.description: Increase the move speed of target Reanimated unit by 3 until its next combat.

warcry.name: Warcry
warcry.description: All your units have +1 Power for one turn.

web.name: Web
web.description: Reduce an enemy units Move Speed by 4. Range 12.

wildform.name: Wildform
wildform.description: Caster has +1 Power,  +1 Defense and +2 Attacks for one turn.
